newsitem.title: THAILAND: SET halts trading in Krungthai Thanakit.
newsitem.headline: SET halts trading in Krungthai Thanakit.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) said it had halted trading in Krungthai Thanakit Plc shares from the afternoon session on Monday.
The SET said in a statement it had asked the firm, a subsidiary of the Krung Thai Bank Plc for further information and was waiting for it to respond. It gave no more details.
The finance and securities firm's shares were down 1.25 baht at 27.75 when trading was halted.
